instruction: GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut or the provided application launch, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Seed library reading suite. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing. The seed file gives an approximate library shell, partition, and column reference so you do not need to start from an empty project. Modify it into a one-storey library suite with an overall footprint about 15 m by 9 m. Create four named rooms: Reading, Stacks, Staff, and Store. Use exterior walls, interior partitions, one floor slab, at least four doors, at least four windows, and two interior columns in the Reading room. The provided seed IFC is an editable starting reference; keep useful geometry, but it is acceptable to redraw simple walls, floors, rooms, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, columns, beams, or curtain walls with native Revit GUI tools if that is faster or cleaner. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail lines or placeholder geometry. Use the Revit Room tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 or IFC2x3 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Reading, Stacks, Staff, Store; at least 1 building storeys, at least 7 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 4 doors, at least 4 windows, at least 2 columns; no IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. The overall model extents should be about 15 m by 9 m horizontally and about 3.2 m tall, with ordinary Revit modeling tolerance. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, relationship nesting, and harmless metadata may vary.
